title: Hardcoded JWT Secret Fallback in Authentication Handler
observed_behavior: When the JWT_SECRET environment variable is unset, the service falls back to a predictable static string.
expected_behavior: The service must fail fast with a fatal startup error if JWT_SECRET is unset in production environments.
root_cause: Permissive default fallback in auth initialization.
impact: Attackers can forge arbitrary authentication tokens when JWT_SECRET is missing.
reproduction: Unset JWT_SECRET and issue a signed token using the hardcoded secret; the server accepts it.
remediation: Replace unwrap_or_else with explicit error propagation and fail fast on boot.
preconditions: The server must be booted without JWT_SECRET in environment.
likelihood_justification: Common to miss environment variables in staging/production deployments.
exposure_evidence: auth.rs#L52 entrypoint exposed to public HTTP request pipeline.

transforms: Fallback unwrap_or_else to hardcoded static string
taint_chain.impact: Arbitrary auth token forgery and authentication bypass
